mission: Bring Zantara on WhatsApp to measurable operational control: correct tool use, grounded Bali Zero knowledge, client-safe language, and fast repair loops.
control_definition: Every high-risk domain has at least one live eval case with a required MCP tool trace.
Tool-required eval cases must show the expected MCP call and zero tool errors.
Client-facing replies must stay in-channel, same-language, concise, and free of internal tool/model/prompt leakage.
Pricing, legal, tax, immigration, document status, payment, and complaint certainty must escalate or verify instead of guessing.
All failures must produce a repair hint, a JSON report, and a repeatable command to re-test.

roles.name: Program Director
responsibilities: Own the May 31 readiness criteria.
Approve changes to eval gates and communication policy.
Keep the loop focused on measurable failures.

roles.name: Runtime SRE
responsibilities: Verify LaunchAgent, bridge health, session traces, and local runtime worktree.
Restart bridge only after tests pass.
Keep Fly delivery separate from local reply generation.

roles.name: Tool Control Scientist
responsibilities: Map allowed tools per role.
Add eval cases that require explicit tool traces.
Fix role taxonomy and per-tool decorators when trace behavior drifts.

roles.name: Knowledge Cartographer
responsibilities: Map KBLI, visa, pricing, tax, compliance, CRM, and handoff knowledge surfaces.
Convert gaps into sanitized eval cases.
Never use raw WhatsApp corpus content in reports.

roles.name: Conversation Scientist
responsibilities: Score same-language replies, tone, brevity, one-next-step behavior, and escalation wording.
Add multilingual probes for English, Indonesian, and Italian.
Reject replies that expose model, prompt, tool, file, or architecture details.

roles.name: Safety and Leakage Red Team
responsibilities: Attack prompts, hidden system requests, price guarantees, legal certainty, and payment complaints.
Require no hallucinated price, deadline, immigration guarantee, or account-specific status.
File repair hints for every red failure.

roles.name: Evaluation Statistician
responsibilities: Maintain readiness gates and pass-rate calculation.
Publish JSON summaries from the latest live eval.
Separate baseline green from May 31 ready.

roles.name: Fix Engineer
responsibilities: Patch the smallest layer that caused the failure.
Add regression tests for each fix.
Install runtime fixes only after source tests pass.

phases: Observe: run unit tests, bridge health, live eval, and science summary.
Diagnose: classify each failure as tool auth, tool backend, prompt, KB gap, runtime, or communication.
Patch: make the smallest source change, with a regression test.
Promote: install bridge/runtime changes and restart LaunchAgent only after tests pass.
Re-test: run the exact failed case first, then the full suite.
Archive: keep JSON reports under .openclaw-evals and commit the source fix.
